user.title: Connect to BTicino Door Entry
user.description: Enter the credentials used by the official Door Entry app.

locks.title: Select connected door releases
locks.description: Select every physical lock that is still connected to this installation.

turn.title: Optional Cloudflare TURN
turn.description: For viewing from mobile data (CGNAT), add a Cloudflare Realtime TURN key. Leave blank to skip — you can set this later in the integration options. The API token is shown only once in the Cloudflare dashboard.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect BTicino Door Entry
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the current Door Entry account password.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach Door Entry authentication (not necessarily wrong password). Check the Home Assistant log for BTicino auth failure reason_code.
error.select_lock: Select at least one connected door release
error.incomplete_turn: Enter both TURN key ID and API token, or leave both empty
error.installation_data_invalid: Cannot load modules for that installation (HTTP {http_status}, {reason_code}, body {body_kind}). Pick another installation — credentials stay; check the HA log for BTicino API failure.
error.unsupported_installation: No compatible gateway and door lock on that installation. Pick another from the list (no re-login).

abort.installation_data_invalid: Cannot load installation modules (HTTP {http_status}, {reason_code}, body {body_kind}). Check Home Assistant log for BTicino API failure.
abort.no_homes: No Door Entry installation was found
abort.unsupported_installation: No compatible gateway and door lock were found

init.title: BTicino C100X options
init.description: Update door releases and optional Cloudflare TURN for remote viewing. Leave the TURN API token blank to keep the current token.

error.select_lock: Select at least one connected door release
error.incomplete_turn: Enter both TURN key ID and API token, or clear both to remove TURN from options

abort.cannot_connect: Cannot load door releases from Legrand
